title: Chapter 12 Delicious Egg Fried Rice
content:
Chapter 12 Delicious Egg Fried Rice

"Brother, it's finally added, help me!"

"Uh, Brother Huang, why do you say that? You can have supplies like bread, how can you lack resources?"

Wang Shuo joked, seeing that he was so anxious, he must have something to ask of him, Wang Shuo put on airs.

"There, there, brother, I'm in a hurry now. Acid rain has corroded many holes in my wooden house. I plan to upgrade the shelter and urgently need tiles. Help me!" Huang Feiguang said with a smile on his face.

"Uh, then what are you going to exchange for it?"

"How about bread?"

"Uh, I just said, I don't want to eat this kind of junk food that tastes bad."

"What about rice?"

Wang Shuo was a little excited. He even had rice. He was really rich.

But he said calmly: "Uh. Rice, is there anything else?"

"Yes, yes, a fine-grade spear and a scroll of rapid growth."

"Is that all?"

Huang Feiguang's face was a little ugly. He also saw that Wang Shuo was trying to make things difficult for him.

But now the tiles are life-saving supplies, so he had no choice but to hold back.

"There is also a well construction blueprint."

Wang Shuo stopped when he saw the good, after all, you should stop taking advantage of others.

"Well, then, a fine-grade spear, a rapid growth scroll, a well construction blueprint, plus 100 kilograms of rice, in exchange for 100 tiles." Wang Shuo also fought back and opened his mouth.

Huang Feiguang, seeing Wang Shuo's offer, almost cried.

"Brother, I only have 20 kilograms of rice, so I can only exchange 10 kilograms for you. Moreover, the tiles are too few! What I exchange with you are all good things."

Wang Shuo thought about it and said, "The rice must be at least 15 kilograms, and I can give you more tiles, just 200 tiles."

"Deal." Huang Feiguang was silent for a while before he gritted his teeth and agreed. At this moment, his heart was bleeding.

In the past, he always slaughtered others, but this time it was finally his turn.

Heaven has its way, and no one can escape it!

[Long spear (excellent) +1, rapid growth scroll +1, well construction blueprint +1, rice +15 (jin), tiles -200]

To upgrade the stone house, only 100 tiles are needed. It is obvious that Huang Feiguang just wants to upgrade the stone house directly.

As for how he can avoid acid rain when upgrading, Wang Shuo does not need to worry about it.

There are also some people who want to get supplies for free on the grounds that "as human beings, we should support each other".

Wang Shuo is too lazy to pay attention to this kind of people.

His supplies are not blown by the wind. Even if he wants to help more people, he is willing but unable.

In this short while, he also exchanged tiles from other players for: [wood × 400, stone × 500, meat × 20 (kg), eggs × 30 (pieces), feathers × 100 (units), salt × 500 (g), cotton × 20, "rebound necklace" × 1]

It can be said that it is a bumper harvest. What is more exciting is that a player actually gave Wang Shuo an equipment, which seems to be used in exchange for life-saving supplies. He had no choice.

[Rebound necklace: After equipping, energy +1, can double the player's mental strength. ]

Wang Shuo quickly hung it around his neck and instantly felt a little clear-headed. It was much better than the energy recovery effect of the brick house. It was indeed a good thing.

At this time, the [task] also had new changes.

[Main line task]: Survive to the end.

(Current number of survivors in the area: 6180/10000.)

The number of eliminated players has reached nearly 4,000, and Wang Shuo has begun to get used to it.

It's not that he ignores life, but in this cruel environment, everyone lives a precarious life, and has become numb to death and is not surprised.

[Side Quest]

1. Please upgrade the residential house to a residential house as soon as possible.

(Upgrade conditions: 500 wood + 2000 bricks + 1000 tiles + 400 stones + 1 energy crystal.)

(I have to say that you have become the best player in this area. But there are always some people who have adventures you can't imagine, and they are also "hacks". The future may be yours or someone else's, but in the end it belongs to those who work hard. Take action, get out of your comfort zone, and work hard as long as you don't die. After upgrading the residential house, you can unlock more "synthesis formulas", you will have an independent toilet, a spacious front yard, and more surprises waiting for you!)

2. An elite crocodile appeared in your territory, please find and destroy it.

3. The first rain.

(This acid rain is a small test for you. Don't worry, the rain will stop.)

"Fuck you."

Wang Shuo seemed to be pushed forward by a ruthless hand. If his steps were not fast enough, he would fall and be crushed to death.

Seeing the changes in the side quest, Wang Shuo took a deep breath, secretly feeling lucky, but also a little worried about the future.

It seems that this rain will not last long, so food and water will become scarce resources again. Those who have food reserves don't have to panic, but those who have no food to eat will complain again.

Next, he began to visit his new home.

The joy in his heart was beyond words.

This is the first decent property he earned through his own efforts, so he naturally likes it very much.

He was standing in the main room. Looking around, there was a brick bed in the room, which was very conspicuous. There was a small table on the bed.

He climbed onto the brick bed. It was not cold. There must be a fire underneath.

He climbed to the head of the bed and found a stove hole where he could add firewood.

It was very user-friendly.

However, how could he fall asleep without a quilt?

He had already collected cotton, so he quickly took out the "Six-piece bedding set production drawings", clicked to learn, and learned the "Cotton clothes production drawings" by the way.

[Six-piece bedding set: 10 cotton + 2 cotton cloth + 2 cotton thread]

[Cotton clothes (cotton coat + cotton pants): 4 cotton + 1 cotton cloth + 1 cotton thread]

Wang Shuo already had the "synthesis formula" of coarse cloth, and by default he had obtained the "synthesis formula" of cotton cloth.

1 unit of cotton can synthesize 1 unit of cotton cloth, while cotton thread can be almost ignored. 1 cotton can get 100 cotton threads.

Next, there is nothing to say, just make it.

Since he only had 20 units of cotton, he could only make one set of bedding and one set of cotton clothes.

[Six-piece bedding set +1, cotton clothes +1]

He took out the quilt from his backpack and touched it with his hands. It was soft and silky, and felt very good. Wang Shuo exclaimed: "Conscientious goods, definitely a quilt made of new cotton."

When he was in school, the quilt he bought was second-hand black-hearted cotton, and he still remembered it clearly.

He wanted to lie on the bed and experience it, but he saw that his clothes were already dirty.

He smelled it and it was a bit smelly!

So he held back and planned to take a hot bath first and then change into clean cotton clothes.

There was a room on each side of the main hall. On the left hand side was a kitchen, close to the wall of the earthen kang. When cooking, the earthen kang could also be heated. At this time, firewood was also burning in the stove hole. The pot was boiling hot water, and it was steaming.

After getting hot water, Wang Shuo immediately took out a water tank and took a comfortable hot bath.

"So comfortable."

After changing into the cotton clothes made by the system, Wang Shuo instantly felt 120 times more comfortable.

The grilled fish just now was tasteless, and he had no appetite at all, so he took out rice, meat, and eggs and made a fragrant, egg and pork fried rice.

When he smelled the fragrance, Wang Shuo couldn't help but drool!

Sitting on the warm earthen kang, eating the golden color and full grain fried rice, it can be said that the lips and teeth are fragrant, but these are not the point, the point is the salt.

After eating the grilled fish without salt, Wang Shuo almost had no strength and felt uncomfortable all over.

This meal, let's just treat it as a midnight snack!

"This is like life!" Wang Shuo exclaimed.

Eating fried rice, taking a hot bath, wearing cotton clothes, sleeping on a hot kang!

Wang Shuo was very happy at the moment, but soon he recalled the embarrassment when he first arrived.

On the first day, Wang Shuo was so miserable! His cotton pants were soaked, he was almost fainting from hunger, he couldn't make a fire, his hands were blistered, and he almost had to sleep in a shack. If it weren't for the last speed-up scroll, Wang Shuo would have been fed to the crocodile.

Thinking of this, Wang Shuo felt aggrieved and wanted to cry.

But he soon let it go!

Who doesn't have a bad day in life!

"The poorest is nothing more than begging for food, but if you don't die, you will eventually get ahead."

"Those who can't beat us will eventually make us stronger."

After eating and drinking, people tend to get sleepy.

The rain outside the house kept falling, and the rain beat the roof rhythmically. Wang Shuo fell asleep in the sound of raindrops!
